_description: Test plants for the Nymph Plant Knowledge Seeding Skill. The skill supports all 50 US states — the NPDES prefix determines which state agency and portal are used. The Alabama plants below are the primary regression suite. Add plants from other states as needed using the same schema.
_stateSupport: All 50 US states are supported. State routing is determined automatically from the NPDES permit number prefix (AL = Alabama/ADEM, TX = Texas/TCEQ, FL = Florida/FDEP, CA = California/SWRCB, GA = Georgia/EPD, NY = New York/NYSDEC, etc.). See references/state_portal_patterns.md and the NPDES_STATE_MAP in scripts/seed_runner.py for the full mapping.

otherStateExamples._note: These are example command patterns for other states. Substitute real NPDES numbers and plant names. The skill routes to the correct state portal automatically.
otherStateExamples.newYork: python scripts/seed_runner.py --plant "Buffalo WWTP" --location "Buffalo, New York" --npdes NY0000000

runInstructions.withOwner: python scripts/seed_runner.py --plant "Madison WWTP" --location "Madison, Alabama" --npdes AL0071897 --owner "City of Madison"
runInstructions.batchNote: Run each plant separately. Each run creates a <npdes>_seed_package.json output file.
runInstructions.envRequired: OPENAI_API_KEY must be set for PDF parsing. ECHO lookup works without an API key.
